title: SoakBaselineLeakageCanary
description: A canary that flags when a scenario stops discriminating: either the no-skill baseline already produces the correct answer (leaky/non-discriminating scenario needing hardening), or an answer leaks internal/proprietary content it should never contain. Signals are public-safe phrases/patterns only.

canary_kind.description: baseline-already-correct: the no-skill run hitting this signal means the scenario is not discriminating. internal-content-leak: any run hitting this signal exposed content that must never appear.

signal.description: Public-safe phrase or regex fragment whose presence trips the canary.

action.description: harden: strengthen the scenario. reject: fail the run. flag: surface for review.
